updateCadence: Roughly quarterly majors in 2026 (143 Feb, 147 Apr, 150 Jul, 154 Oct)
summary: Long-running Chromium derivative from SRWare that removes Google tracking components (RLZ, update checks, URL tracking), but no built-in blocker or sync and updates lag Chromium by a couple of majors.
bestFor: Users who want vanilla Chromium without Google hooks
Windows users who prefer portable options
notFor: People who need timely security patches
Users who want built-in blocking or sync

pros.title: Google bits removed
pros.detail: Strips Google tracking and update hooks.

pros.title: Cross-desktop
pros.detail: Windows, macOS and Linux builds exist.

pros.title: Portable build
pros.detail: A portable edition is available for Windows.

faq.a: Windows/Linux 154.0.8100.0 (Oct 4, 2026) and macOS posted Oct 15, versus Chromium 156 mainline.
It lags Chromium by about two majors, so security fixes arrive later than Chrome.
Partly; the project publishes some source but the browser is freeware.
